readme: Stall values are reproduced AS REPORTED. IAS is not CAS/EAS. One row is a reported condition, not an independent repeated experimental flight. null means not reported, NEVER zero. Ranges are bounds, not synthetic endpoint samples. Capture source text page/section and audit original image when indicated. Altitude and weight given as test/takeoff or manual-load context, not invented instantaneous stall weight.
